name: Ethiopian Guji Natural Org. Gr. 1 - Kayon Mountain Shakiso
cup_characteristics: Clean, bright, sweet with a very diverse flavor set. Stone and darker fruit, citrus & floral, and spiced chocolate tones. Nice jammy body in medium roasts with a sweet, lingering finish.
roasting_notes: Classic natural processed, fairly even roasting with high chaff. Best around medium roast (City+ to Full City) to develop fruit versus chocolate profile.

name: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Uraga
cup_characteristics: One of our more versatile dry process Ethiopian coffees, from juicy fruits, spiced sweetness, and convincing acidity, to chocolate-driven profiles, orange highlights, and chicory tea.
roasting_notes: City to Full City+. Good for espresso and versatile across a range of roast levels.

name: Colombia Supremo Huila
cup_characteristics: Clean and bright with intense aroma. Light acidity and generous sweetness. Nice preparation.
roasting_notes: Durable, high grown coffee capable of roasts between City Plus (C+) and dark roasts past second crack, and steps in between. The beans are large and dense, having enough acidity to hold up to dark roasting while still being flavorful. If you roast on a Behmor we suggest profile P2 for this coffee. We felt this profile offered the best combination of body and acidity. P3 was also quite decent.

name: Brazil Mogiana 15/16 FC SS - Cooxupé
cup_characteristics: Thick, creamy, nutty, and semi-sweet with full body and low acidity. Baker's chocolate, toasted walnut, and a subtle hint of smoke.
roasting_notes: Versatile medium to dark roaster (Full City to Full City+). Excellent thick, creamy crema for single-origin espresso or as an espresso blend base.
